title: UFO expert claims that the South Pole is an 'air traffic control' for aliens
description: You may have been hearing a lot about UFOs in recent years, and that’s largely thanks to Ufologist Dr. Steven Greer who has hosted a number of now-viral conferences on the topic.However, one that stood out in particular took place in 2023, when a range of people were invited to share their insights ...

title: Pentagon creates legal waiver allowing personnel sworn to UFO secrecy to come forward
description: The Pentagon is now allowing current and former personnel sworn to secrecy about Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena (UAP) activity to legally share that information with the government.

title: Lầu Năm Góc cho phép nhân viên tiết lộ thông tin mật về UFO
description: Lầu Năm Góc đã cho phép nhân viên cung cấp cho các quan chức có thẩm quyền những thông tin mật về vật thể bay không xác định (UFO) mà họ tiếp cận được trong quá trình công tác - Bộ Chiến tranh Mỹ cho biết.

title: Loeb says new waivers may provide critical insight into UAP claims
